Its [official MCP API page](https://developer.broadcom.com/xapis/vmware-private-ai-service-api/latest/mcp-servers/) manages registrations for existing servers; it does not implement a vCenter/ESXi adapter. “Every VM that hosts our application” is not an executable target set. Resolve vCenter/ESXi versions, exact inventory scope, explicit VM identifiers, application role/dependency mapping, current state, HA/replica quorum and the reported failure.
